summary: GigaMedia Limited furnished a Form 6-K carrying its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, a routine foreign-private-issuer results announcement (US equivalent: an 8-K earnings exhibit). Revenue was $3.16 million, up 48.8% quarter-on-quarter and 245.4% year-over-year, with gross profit of $2.00 million, operating income of $0.68 million and net income of $1.93 million. The company also disclosed conversion of Aeolus Robotics notes into preferred shares carrying a 33.35% voting stake, producing a $1.70 million deemed disposal gain and a $13.65 million carrying value. No special-situations transaction is present; watch for revenue moderation and impairment reviews.
